name: quenching
description: Marketplace hosting the quenching mods: quenching-hud, the band above the prompt that shows the worktree's active quenching spec, and quenching-vitrine, the pane of the specs a session touched and the quenching configuration. The quenching surface itself is not a plugin: it is installed into each target repository with `cq deploy`.

plugins.name: quenching-hud
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: the worktree's active quenching spec, its stage and task progress, read through cq specs status --no-fetch. Runs only git branch --show-current and cq specs status; writes no spec or branch and never fetches: it reads the local refs/remotes/origin/quenching, so the band can lag the remote.

plugins.name: quenching-vitrine
plugins.description: Specs pane for Claude Desktop and the terminal: the specs this session touched, each document in tabs, dependencies and epics, and the quenching configuration. Reads through cq specs and cq config; its only write is cq config set|unset on request. Installed separately from the skills; cq deploy never installs it.
